name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Fasten the low cable cuff around one ankle and face the machine with a slight forward lean.
Drive the cuffed leg behind you from the hip while keeping the knee softly bent.
Bring the foot back beneath your hip without letting the stack drop.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep both hip bones facing the machine.
Avoid arching your lower back to swing your leg higher.
